messages:
Maya (CS): Quick sync — compiling Q1 signals from onboarding & renewal-risk accounts for product. Please drop top 2 asks per account here. TL;DR we need to hit renewals with targeted fixes :mag:

Juan (AE): Brightlane — asks: 1) per-route cost reporting granularity (they want daily, by feature) 2) retry backoff config in console. Renewal in 45 days. Churn risk medium.

Sophia (Product): thanks. Can you add severity + repro steps? We'll bucket into 'cost visibility', 'config UX', 'bugs', 'missing capability'.

Eli (Support): My notes from Brightlane call: 'reports show weird spikes when embedding large batches' — ticket 4572. Also asking for example queries for per-route filtering.

Maya (CS): Added severity=high for cost reporting. @Juan can you paste the exact quote or link to their docs? Also tagging @Sophia for prioritization.

Juan (AE): Quote: 'We can't reconcile daily spend across features; finance blocks renewal until this is fixed.' Link: https://internal.example.com/brightlane-ask (internal)

Sophia (Product): Proposed rubric for prioritization: impact (revenue/usage), frequency (occurrences/week), effort (S/M/L). Let's map each ask. Example: cost reporting = Impact=High, Frequency=Daily, Effort=Small (export + filter).

Maya (CS): Love that. Can someone add other accounts? Nimbus had onboarding friction w/ API keys — wants auto-rotate + clearer error codes.

Eli (Support): Nimbus details: error code 401 on token exchange, ambiguous message. Ticket 4620. Severity=medium.

Juan (AE): SummitHealth wants a guided onboarding checklist in Console and sample prompts for healthcare PII handling. Renewal in 90 days.

Sophia (Product): I'll open a small spike to prototype checklist + error-message copy. Can we consolidate asks into a single GH issue per bucket? Use label: cs-signal/q1.

Maya (CS): I'll create a doc with rows: account, ask, quote/link, severity, renewal_date. Quick template:

```
Account | Ask | Severity | Quote/Link | Renewal
```

Dropping in #product-docs after this.

onboard-bot: 3 survey responses ingested from Brightlane (NPS 6) — posted to thread.

Juan (AE): thanks all. I'll keep update here. :thumbsup:
